tasks.work: Audit dependency risk, secrets in staged files, package vulnerabilities; documented risk acceptance jika ada.

tasks.title: CI read-only human commits
tasks.work: CI hanya lint/typecheck/test/build/scan, permission contents:read; jangan jalankan bot auto-commit/push, never stage .md/.mdx per kebijakan pengguna.

tasks.title: Performance/limits
tasks.work: Ukur response katalog/sort pada data uji realistis, index usage, rate limits, startup/env failure; jangan klaim SLO tanpa pengukuran.

tasks.title: Logging/monitoring
tasks.work: Request ID dan sanitized logs, errors/5xx, auth failures, R2 upload errors, DB metrics; jangan log token/PII/presigned URL.

tasks.title: Backup & recovery rehearsal
tasks.work: Buktikan restore Neon dev/staging branch serta metadata/foto R2, cek referential consistency, tetapkan RPO/RTO bersama operator.
tasks.evidence: Restore drill record dan rollback procedure.

tasks.title: Hardening Gate
tasks.work: Audit integrasi dan security dengan status PASS/FAIL/NOT RUN, severity, ownership, blocker; STOP bila critical belum tertangani.

tasks.title: Persetujuan operasional
tasks.work: Tentukan pengelola, petugas resmi, pemilik data, SOP verifikasi pemilik, data retention, privacy notice; tanpa menganggap kampus memberi izin.

tasks.title: Staging environment
tasks.work: Siapkan env terpisah dan domain/HTTPS sesuai izin; migration/seed uji; buka Swagger terbatas, tidak mengumbar debug.
tasks.evidence: Staging smoke test dan secret-safe config.

tasks.title: UAT alur nyata
tasks.work: Uji penerimaan temuan, registrasi langsung, public catalog, laporan student, retur/penyaluran jika scope disetujui.
tasks.evidence: UAT matrix with named roles not PII.

tasks.title: Deployment guard
tasks.work: Lakukan deploy hanya setelah approval eksplisit, migration preview, rollback dan backup checkpoint. Tidak menyentuh produksi tanpa izin.

tasks.title: Pilot Pos Pengajaran
tasks.work: Aktifkan hanya Pos Pengajaran, pos lainnya disiapkan secara skema tetapi tidak diaktifkan tanpa keputusan.
tasks.evidence: Pilot scope approval and measured outcomes.

tasks.title: Operasional & handoff
tasks.work: Siapkan incident contact, credential rotation SOP, support FAQ, maintenance and bug backlog; bukti transfer pengetahuan.

tasks.title: Pilot exit review
tasks.work: Evaluasi usability, stability, privacy, defects, next backlog; jangan klaim production-ready otomatis.
